cohort: 209 children aged 0-5 years visiting clinical growth and developmental services in Malang, Indonesia.
finding: Factors associated with developmental delay in the first five years of children included being male, being aged above two years, birth by caesarean section, and maternal age above 35 years.
mod_finding: Children born by caesarean section had a significantly higher risk of developmental delay (AOR=5.01; 95 % CI = 2.25-11.15).
cross-section timing: Children were assessed cross-sectionally between 0 and 5 years of age.
